exigences.requirement: The bidder must obtain a CCNA certification from Cisco at the Associate level.

The bidder must obtain an ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor certification from ISO/IEC at the Professional level.
The bidder must obtain an ITIL Foundation certification from Axelos at the Foundation level.
The bidder must generate a single PDF bill for split large accounts.
The bidder must provide a web application for managing, running, monitoring, and reporting the proposed solution.
The bidder must ensure the target architecture of the proposed solution is in disaster recovery mode (Active-Active or Active-Passive) based on Ooredoo infrastructure standards.
The bidder must generate a single PDF invoice for split large accounts.
The bidder must have expertise in Cisco IOS / IOS-XE.
The bidder must have advanced proficiency in BGP (Border Gateway Protocol).
The bidder must have advanced proficiency in OSPF (Open Shortest Path First).
The bidder must have intermediate proficiency in Oracle DB / SQL.
The bidder must have advanced proficiency in XML / PDF Generation (iText, XSL-FO).
The bidder must have intermediate proficiency in Java / REST API Integration.
The bidder must have intermediate proficiency in Linux / Shell Scripting.
The bidder must provide a copy of its ISO 27001 certification if it exists.
The bidder must provide a list of two reference accounts for similar projects in telecom operators during the last 10 years.
The bidder must include the company name, contact name and title, phone number, email address, and brief project description for each reference account.
The bidder must design a new bill layout to improve customer satisfaction.
The bidder must provide training services and methods for delivering theoretical and practical training to both engineering and support technical teams with at least 8 persons.
The bidder must provide a brief overview of their professional and integration services organization, including the schedule of the transition process and the hand over.

The bidder must describe the strategy and scope for support and maintenance of the bill generation solution, including the bidder's role and responsibility, a RAC, and an escalation matrix for unavailability.

The bidder must provide a financial performance summary including financial information on their company, such as annual reports, profit growth history for the past three years, and the average ratio of implementation services versus annuity business.
The bidder must provide copies of certifications for team members who are solution certified.
The bidder must ensure that team members are suitable, appropriately qualified, experienced and competent personnel.
The bidder must ensure that each team member assigned to the Bill Generation Solution project has at least 5 years of professional experience in the specified domains.
The vendor must respond to each requirement specification by providing a compliance summary statement.
The bidder must modify the bill design to fit the business requirements.
The bidder must support any future bill design changes.
The bidder must provide full automation and full integration capabilities.

The bidder must agree to confidentiality terms and written agreement with Ooredoo Tunisia, and ensure that any disclosure to sub-contractors or contracted participants is subject to non-disclosure obligations applicable to the third party.
The bidder must provide a graphical interactive interface for bill design customization.
The bidder must produce a unified XML file for each bill.
The bidder must insert bill details into database tables.
The bidder must produce bills in PDF format.
The bidder must send bills by email.
The bidder must produce and send call details in CSV format.
The bidder must create a single PDF bill for several invoices.
The bidder must select one and only one acceptable compliance statement from the compliance summary statement's compliance column.

The bidder must submit a Company Profile containing the company profile as requested in the Bidder Company Background section, a list of previously completed work related to similar implementations, and responsibilities carried out in the subject domain over the past years including client names.
The bidder must submit an Overall Solution Concept including the technology platform and products.
The bidder must submit a Requirements Compliance Matrix covering functional, technical, operational, security, and infrastructure requirements using the provided MS Excel file.
The bidder must submit a detailed response to Ooredoo’s Goals and Objectives as business requirements.
The bidder must submit detailed responses to the Implementation, Training Services, and Support & Maintenance sections.
The bidder must submit a Product/Solution Licensing Model based on the requirements in the Licensing Model Section.
The bidder must submit a list of Vendors/Third Parties/System Integrators they may be partnering with.
The bidder must highlight any key assumptions or additional value-add in the response.
The bidder must submit any additional information they deem necessary to support the RFP response.
The bidder must request the required infrastructure resources based on the application requirements.
The technical solution must be optimized to address the slowness of the document generation process and the complexity of design changes implementation.
The bidder must hold a Bac+5 / Master's Degree in Computer Networks or Telecom Engineering with an Engineer / MSc equivalence.
The bidder must hold a Bac+3 / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or IT with a BSc / Licence equivalence.
The bidder must provide an emergency service with an initial response time of 1 hour and a restoration-workaround time of 1 working day.
The bidder must provide a trouble resolution service with an initial response time of 1 hour and a workaround time of 1 working day.
The bidder must provide a trouble resolution service with a priority 1 issue requiring a final solution/correction within 5 working days.
The bidder must provide a trouble resolution service with a priority 2 issue requiring a final solution/correction within 10 working days.
The bidder must provide a trouble resolution service with a priority 3 issue requiring a final solution/correction within 2 weeks.
The bidder must have existed for at least 5 years at the submission deadline.
The project lead and key technical team members must have a minimum academic qualification.
The solution must address technical limitations and provide flexibility for extensions and evolutions of bill design.
The solution must resolve performance issues related to slow PDF bill generation (20k bills per hour).
The solution must resolve performance issues related to high server resource usage (CPU/Memory).
The bidder must provide and implement a bill generation solution that is standard, preconfigured, fully automated, scalable, and reliable.
The bidder must provide a document and page number cross-reference for compliance verification.
The bidder must provide a bill generation solution that includes functional and technical requirements.

The bidder must describe their company organization and include specific data such as company name and address, contact details, headquarter address, local sales address, years in business under this name, previous company names, and years in business under previous names.
The bidder must not disclose any information provided by Ooredoo Tunisia to third parties without specific written agreement.
The bidder must provide the Ericsson BSCSIX R3 (BCH) billing application.
The bidder must use Oracle DB Release 11.1.0.7 for the billing database.
The bidder must have experience in the Telecommunication sector.
The bidder must provide a technical solution that meets the requirements outlined in the attached file 'OT Bill Generation Solution Requirement v1.xls'.
The bidder must not be non-compliant with any of the main scope items detailed in this document.

The bidder must provide copies of certifications held.

The vendor must provide experienced instructors to deliver the lectures in the courses.
The vendor must offer a list of suggested external training if applicable.
The bidder must comply with the eligibility criteria outlined in the Financial Performance section.
